people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

people.name: Kidron
people.line: A valley east of Jerusalem, site of significant events

translations.web: When Jesus had spoken these words, he went out with his disciples over the brook Kidron, where there was a garden, into which he and his disciples entered.
translations.bsb: After Jesus had spoken these words, He went out with His disciples across the Kidron Valley, where they entered a garden.
translations.kjv: When Jesus had spoken these words, he went forth with his disciples over the brook Cedron, where was a garden, into the which he entered, and his disciples.
translations.asv: When Jesus had spoken these words, he went forth with his disciples over the brook Kidron, where was a garden, into which he entered, himself and his disciples.
